card.title: Tradition Outranks Explanation
card.instruction: Treat inherited customs as meaningful because they have been repeated. Preserve each step and resist every request to explain why it still matters.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Set an empty bowl for Great-Uncle Arthur before we serve dinner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then he'll finally get to see his bowl.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we put soup in it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not after forty years of keeping it empty for him.

mechanism: A treats the empty bowl's forty years of repetition as reason to preserve it even when the honored person is present and could eat.
confusable: Unlike a ritual serving current comfort or practical meaning, A resists changing the step because repetition itself is the justification.
comparison: The bowl alternative preserves emptiness despite Arthur's arrival; the boat alternative rejects useful prior walking because it differs from the inherited sequence.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
